name: zdeclient_crater_instance_event_maybe_relay
description: zDEClient_Crater::InstanceEventMaybeRelay handles the optional crater net relay before dispatching crater feature instancing with effect animation enabled.
known_limits: The smoke target covers relay rejection, accepted relay dispatch into InstanceEvent, and null-relay dispatch into InstanceEvent with vertex-merge epsilon restoration; full success-side crater geometry submission is covered through accepted InstanceEvent and lower zDEClient crater feature targets.
tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zDEClient crater/clip-patch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x456c50 validates loading g_zDEClientCraterNetRelayCallback, returning -1 when the callback exists and returns zero, otherwise calling zDEClient_Crater::InstanceEvent with playEffectAnim set to 1.

The native smoke verifies relay rejection calls the callback once and does not disturb vertex-merge epsilon, accepted relay dispatch reaches InstanceEvent failure cleanup, and a null relay also dispatches to InstanceEvent.
